source.archive: data/cache/*_props_history.db for dates the templates board does not cover
source.game_logs: MLB stats cache (2025+2026), WNBA ESPN cache (2025+2026), historical_actuals player_game_logs (prior season through this season), Sackmann tennis matches
source.also: median gap on the same side, and count of last-10 games clearing the line by the prop cover unit
source.filter: directional L5=5, at least 8 of the last 10 games present, DNP and tennis retirement/walkover out
source.holdout: per sport, dates on or after that sport's 70% date. The window uses the previous season's games.
source.shuffle: 200 draws, labels shuffled inside the date, score is the high-tercile hit rate

summary.note: A rising holdout is a description. blocked_reason says why it is not a gate.
